# taylor desseyn

> taylor desseyn: helping job seekers use ai to land their next role. host of guidance counselor 2.0, the tech career podcast. weekly ai job search notes at taylordesseyn.beehiiv.com · more at tdesseyn.com every guidance counselor 2.0 episode below has its own page with a summary, 3 takeaways and a full transcript.
